name: Eversmoking Bottle

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Open
powers.text: Magic action: thick smoke pours out and fills 60 ft around the bottle (Heavily Obscured) until you stopper it.

powers.name: Stopper it
powers.text: Magic action: stopper the bottle; the smoke disperses.

summary: Opened, it pours out smoke that heavily obscures everything within 60 ft.
text: Smoke leaks from the lead-stoppered mouth of this brass bottle, which weighs 1 pound. When you take a Magic action to remove the stopper, a cloud of thick smoke pours out in a 60-foot Emanation from the bottle. The cloud's area is Heavily Obscured. Each minute the bottle remains open and within the cloud, the radius increases by 10 feet until it reaches its maximum radius of 120 feet. The cloud persists as long as the bottle is open. Closing the bottle requires you to take a Magic action to speak its command word. Once the bottle is closed, the cloud disperses after 10 minutes. A moderate wind disperses the smoke after 1 minute, and a strong wind does so after 1 round.
